queries: WITH site_groups AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage, AVG(ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu)) AS avg_cpu_gpu_difference FROM scanprocessing AS sp JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), group_means AS (SELECT site_groups.*, AVG(avg_remaining_storage) OVER () AS mean_group_storage FROM site_groups) SELECT site_code, insurance_status, avg_remaining_storage, avg_cpu_gpu_difference, avg_remaining_storage / NULLIF(mean_group_storage, 0) AS storage_ratio FROM group_means WHERE mean_group_storage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH site_averages AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage, AVG(ABS(p.proccpu - p.procgpu)) AS avg_cpu_gpu_difference FROM scanprocessing AS p JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), scored AS (SELECT *, AVG(avg_remaining_storage) OVER () AS mean_group_storage FROM site_averages) SELECT site_code, insurance_status, avg_remaining_storage, avg_cpu_gpu_difference, avg_remaining_storage / NULLIF(mean_group_storage, 0) AS storage_ratio FROM scored WHERE mean_group_storage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH site_groups AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage, AVG(ABS(p.proccpu - p.procgpu)) AS avg_absolute_cpu_gpu_difference FROM scanprocessing AS p JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_storage) AS mean_group_storage FROM site_groups) SELECT g.site_code, g.insurance_status, g.avg_remaining_storage, g.avg_absolute_cpu_gpu_difference, g.avg_remaining_storage / NULLIF(m.mean_group_storage, 0) AS storage_ratio FROM site_groups AS g CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE m.mean_group_storage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
